in_sanskrit.name: प्रभा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who illuminates or shines, a symbol of knowledge and wisdom.

in_hindi.name: प्रभा
in_hindi.long_meaning: Prakash (light), tapasvi (ascetic), dhoop (incense). Prabha is a name of the Goddess Lakshmi and Saraswati.

in_tamil.name: பிரபா
in_tamil.long_meaning: Prappu (light), kalai (time), vijayam (victory). Prabha is a name of the Goddess Mariamman.

in_telugu.name: ప్రభా
in_telugu.long_meaning: Prabhatu (dawn), pRithvi (earth), dipe (lamp). Prabha is a name of the Goddess Mahalakshmi and Saraswati.

in_marathi.name: Prabha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prabha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of Light, Radiance, and Brightness. The sun is a symbol of Prabha.

in_bengali.name: Prabha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Radiant, Bright
in_bengali.long_meaning: Prabha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Goddess of Light, Radiance, and Brightness. The sun is a symbol of Prabha.
